_note: The grounds on which a sum or property received is outside the charge on gifts, by the ground claimed (gift.exclusion, the GiftExclusion name) and, where a ground reaches sums only, the kind received (gift.kind, the GiftKind name) (W-156f, D-351; D-201). A ground the year's version does not reach is refused. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(3): "(2)(m) shall not apply to any sum of money or any property received— (a) from any relative; or (b) on the occasion of marriage of the individual; or (c) under a will or by way of inheritance; or (d) in contemplation of death of the payer or donor; or (e) from any local authority …; or (f) from or by any registered non-profit organisation as defined in section 355(g), except when received by any person referred to in section 355(h); or (g) by way of a transaction not regarded as transfer under section 70(1) …; or (h) from an individual by a trust created or established solely for the benefit of relative of the individual; or (i) from such class of persons and subject to such conditions, as may be prescribed" (egazette 2025/265620 pp.139–140); it has no COVID-19 ground. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.56(2)(x) proviso: (I) – (X), the same grounds, with (VI) – (VIII) as NON_PROFIT; (XI) the prescribed class, inserted by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2019 (egazette 2019/209695 p.14); (XII) the COVID-19 medical treatment and (XIII) the receipts of the family of a person whose death was related to COVID-19, (A) from the employer and (B) from any other person, inserted by the Finance Act, 2022 s.16(b), deemed from 1-4-2020 (egazette 2022/234693 p.26). (XIII)(B) reaches "such sum or aggregate of such sums" only, so property is not reached on it; its limit is OS-GIFT-COVID-DEATH's. Introduction and provenance are OS-GIFT's. Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-17-gifts.md A2, B1, B4, B8.
